purpose: Development-only hostile benchmark pack. Not a world-number-one claim and not an Astra substitute.

tasks.question: A system passes 100 unit tests written by the same team that built it. What is the strongest defensible conclusion?
tasks.context: No independent replication, unseen benchmark, or external audit has been performed.

options.B: The tested behaviors passed the team's test suite

tasks.question: Four calls from the same model family agree. Can they be counted as four independent confirmations?
tasks.context: All calls use the same underlying model family and the same supplied evidence.

tasks.question: At 17:07 UTC, a five-minute bar started at 17:05. May a forward test treat it as completed?
tasks.context: A bar is completed only when start + 5 minutes <= as_of.

options.C: Yes if the price is finite

tasks.question: Source code contains a recovery function but it has never been exercised against the real database. What is proven?
tasks.context: There is no runtime trace, transaction test, or recovery artifact.

options.B: The recovery path exists in source

tasks.question: A model feature is computed using a value revised two days after the forecast timestamp. Is that feature valid for a prospective forecast?
tasks.context: The unrevised value available at forecast time was different.

options.A: Yes, because revisions are more accurate
options.B: Yes, if the model is unchanged
options.C: No; this is future/revised information leakage

tasks.question: A required evidence source is stale and there is no valid fallback. What should a fail-closed system do?
tasks.context: The missing source is marked mandatory by the frozen protocol.

tasks.question: Prime is tuned after seeing Astra's answers, then tested again on the same questions. What is the main scientific risk?
tasks.context: No fresh held-out tasks are introduced.

tasks.question: A private service log accidentally prints an API password and is later patched to redact it. What remains necessary?
tasks.context: The old secret may already have been exposed in historical logs.

options.B: Rotate the affected credential and verify future logs

tasks.question: Model A scores 20/20 and Model B 18/20 on one small hand-built task pack. What can be concluded?
tasks.context: Task-generation independence and representativeness are unknown.

options.B: A scored higher on this pack; broader superiority is not proven

tasks.question: A deployment health endpoint returns HTTP 200, but the core worker has never processed a real job. What is the strongest conclusion?
tasks.context: The endpoint only reports that the web process is alive.

options.B: The web process is reachable; core execution remains unproven

tasks.question: An attack finds no defect. What should Ultra Mode do next before declaring success?
tasks.context: The first attacker and builder share assumptions.

options.B: Run a counter-attack that tries to break the rejection and seek different failure modes

tasks.question: Prime beats Astra on a frozen CLEAR-NASDAQ forensic benchmark. Which claim is justified?
tasks.context: No broad coding, math, science, multilingual, long-horizon, or external independent benchmark has been run.

options.A: Prime is the world's best AI
options.B: Prime beat Astra on this tested benchmark
